intro: The Wolf Heart Sample is a preserved parcel of diseased wolf flesh transported from the blighted woodlands of Lordaeron to Kalimdor. Carried on behalf of the Royal Apothecary Society, it provides vital material for studying how northern plagues interact with the fauna of the Barrens.

p: Harvested from the plagued wolves wandering the ruins of Lordaeron, this heart sample was originally collected through the efforts of Apothecary Renferrel before being packaged for transport across the Great Sea. The Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society relentlessly seeks to expand its mastery over venom, blights, and biological reagents. Dispatched via courier to the Crossroads in the Barrens, the parcel represents the long reach of Undercity's chemical endeavors, connecting experiments in the scarred Eastern Kingdoms directly to the frontier outposts of Kalimdor.

Upon arrival at the Crossroads, the sample is delivered into the hands of Apothecary Helbrim. Helbrim's field research centers on observing how the potent toxins born of Lordaeron's Scourge-ravaged landscape affect or adapt to the native wildlife of Kalimdor. By studying the toxicity preserved inside these wolf hearts, Helbrim hopes to uncover novel properties to refine and empower Forsaken poisons and elixirs far from home.
